metadata.title: Nvidia's Latest Rebound Comes With Fresh Support

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Semiconductor maker Nvidia (NVDA, Financials) ticked higher in premarket trade after three straight sessions of losses as investors balanced increased buying activity against larger concerns about AI spending.That bounce followed a purchase of around 78,965 shares of Nvidia in numerous exchange-traded funds by Cathie Wood's ARK Invest, valued at about $15.5 million. Wood also bought into Tesla and SpaceX amid the recent dip in the market.Nvidia shares dipped after rumors that the business was in talks to finance OpenAI's next AI data center project. Investors are also beginning to worry about rising AI infrastructure costs and more competition in the semiconductor sector.Wall Street remains constructive on Nvidia's long-term prospects, despite recent turmoil. Still, analysts point to solid demand for AI accelerators and long-term supply deals with memory makers as possible sources of future development.Nvidia now has an analyst consensus rating of Strong Buy and an average price target of $428.47, meaning around 57% upside from present levels.Investors will be watching to see if AI infrastructure investment, consumer demand and future industry advancements may help revive momentum in Nvidia shares.
